outcome: alcohol consumption in the last 30 days
cohort: The study included 16,875 adults and 23,206 women from the Demographic and Family Health Survey 2022 in Peru, categorized as Afro-descendant or non-Afro-descendant.
finding: Afro-descendant populations in Peru face worse living conditions reflected in various health, nutrition, and well-being indicators compared to non-Afro-descendant counterparts.
mod_finding: Afro-descendant women had a lower proportion of cesarean sections and institutional deliveries compared to non-Afro-descendant women.
